This Resume Template is still not acceptable as an Operations Analyst resume. The overall header design and two-column structure are good and should be preserved, but the professional content remains largely Marketing Manager content rather than Operations Analyst content.

The left sidebar has significant layout problems. The Skills content is visually scattered with inconsistent wrapping and spacing, and the Certifications section contains visible overlapping/colliding text. Remove marketing-specific Experience content such as campaigns, demand generation, ABM, MQLs, nurture sequences, brand messaging, webinars, and marketing attribution.

Ensure all Experience bullets focus on realistic Operations Analyst responsibilities such as process analysis, KPI monitoring, operational reporting, workflow improvement, root-cause analysis, documentation, stakeholder coordination, and efficiency improvements.
Replace the current marketing-focused Skills with Operations Analyst skills and tools appropriate for the target role.
Reorganize the Skills section into a clean, readable structure with consistent line spacing and wrapping; the skills must not appear scattered, cramped, duplicated, or visually disconnected.
Remove marketing-specific skills including Demand Generation, Brand Strategy, ABM, SEO / Content, Marketing Analytics, and Sales Enablement.

Keep useful Operations Analyst skills such as Documentation, Process Design, stakeholder communication, operational analysis, process improvement, KPI reporting, data analysis, Excel, reporting, and workflow optimization where appropriate.

Replace the Always-On ABM Pilot project with a realistic Operations Analyst project focused on process improvement, operational reporting, workflow optimization, KPI dashboards, efficiency improvement, or cost/time reduction.
Replace the marketing-specific Certifications with certifications or professional training appropriate for an Operations Analyst profile.
Remove Google Analytics IQ, HubSpot Inbound Marketing, Meta Blueprint, and other marketing-specific certifications unless they are genuinely relevant to the revised Operations Analyst profile.
Fix the visible overlapping/colliding text in the Certifications section so every certification line is fully readable and separated by clear positive vertical spacing.
Correct the Certifications text-box heights, line heights, wrapping, and vertical positions so no line renders on top of another line.
Ensure there is clear positive spacing between the end of the Certifications section and the Languages heading.

Rebalance the entire left sidebar vertically so Skills, Projects, Certifications, and Languages use the available sidebar space evenly instead of being compressed near the top with excessive empty space below.
Ensure every sidebar text object stays fully inside the sidebar column and does not clip, overflow, overlap, or extend into another section.
Maintain consistent vertical spacing between the Skills, Projects, Certifications, and Languages section headings and their content.
Update the Education content where necessary so the qualifications are coherent with the Operations Analyst professional profile rather than a Marketing Manager profile.
Do not solve the role mismatch by changing only the header title; Summary, Experience, Skills, Projects, Certifications, and Education context must all consistently represent Operations Analyst.

Preserve the existing dark navy header, two-column architecture, light sidebar background, blue section markers, typography hierarchy, and overall visual identity because those parts of the design are working well.
Do not change the candidate name or contact-information structure unless a small positioning adjustment is required for safe rendering.
Check the full page after all content changes and ensure there are no text overlaps, clipped text, duplicate text, out-of-bounds objects, or accidental collisions.
Ensure all section headings and body text maintain clear positive spacing and that no text touches or visually merges with another section.
Use the available page space efficiently and avoid both compressed content clusters and unnecessarily large unexplained gaps.

Before returning this revision to Founder Review, verify that the rendered professional title, Summary, Experience, Skills, Projects, Certifications, and Education all match the target role Operations Analyst.
Before returning this revision to Founder Review, verify that text overlap count is zero, page out-of-bounds count is zero, and every text block is fully readable.
Return a clean one-page Operations Analyst Resume Template with the existing strong visual architecture preserved but with the role content and sidebar geometry fully corrected.
